item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-03
item.description:
The open-source research community has seen significant progress across multiple projects. Notably, the `scienceverse/metacheck` and `giladfeldman/escicheck` projects have made updates to their data handling and version syncing, respectively, with `escicheck` now aligned with `effectcheck` version `0.6.14`. Meanwhile, `Davidvandijcke/coarse` has enhanced its security and documentation, including the addition of a "Buy Me a Coffee" support button, while `JamieCummins/regcheck` has resolved several issues, including bugs with its demo page, card preview, and survey routes. Additionally, `shaheedazaad/auto-zcurve` has made fixes to its R installer, demonstrating the community's commitment to refining its tools. These updates highlight the connections between projects and the community's dedication to improving its research tools. Overall, the community is celebrating a period of productive development and collaboration.

30 commits across 5 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.1

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

item.title: scrutiny: activity update
item.description:
lhdjung/scrutiny

The `main` branch saw changes to the CITATION.cff file, with Lukas Jung updating it, and later adding a `date-released` field. The `gh-pages` branch was deployed to twice, first from commit `a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009` and then from `0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238`, with the message "Deploying to gh-pages" accompanying both deployments. Both deployments were marked with a rocket ship emoji, indicating a release or deployment, as noted by the commit messages "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@a81cd540332cf402c1ffc798f93534c31da17009 🚀" and "Deploying to gh-pages from @ lhdjung/scrutiny@0fd47d0e2ffee48a24c1806c4e4bcd2da5d4e238 🚀". The `main` branch changes were made by Lukas Jung, as stated in the commit messages "Update CITATION.cff" and "Update CITATION.cff with `date-released`".

⚠ This repository was dormant and has recently become active again.
